_comment: Stage 3 feature-contract settings (spec 9.9, 9.10.2-9.10.4, 9.14.3). Changing any value requires rebuilding the features into a new folder.
issue_time: start of the target service day (00:00 local)
_reporting_delay_note: Assumed, not verified (spec 9.10.4): on virtual day D, rides through D - reporting_delay_days may be used. A lag of k days is usable only if k >= reporting_delay_days.
archive_availability_policy: conservative: an archive is usable for forecasts issued on dates strictly after its capture date (available_from = captured + 1 day), spec 9.14.3

sunday_service_holidays._observance_rule_note: US federal observed-holiday rule (5 U.S.C. 6103(b) / OPM): a holiday falling on a Saturday is observed on the Friday before; one falling on a Sunday is observed on the Monday after. The predictor marks the OBSERVED date. This is an official rule published in advance, adopted as a documented rule, not fitted to the ridership outcome. 'dates' below are the actual calendar dates of each holiday.
sunday_service_holidays._source: CTA runs a Sunday schedule on these six holidays: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day. This is CTA's general practice, entered as a fixed calendar known in advance; it has not been checked against a dated CTA notice in this project. It is compared with the reported daytype in the Stage 3 report.
